comparison_scope: The 336 unique raster blobs in GEMSDOE47 visible-artifact audit inventory, fetched by their listed repository/path and verified against the recorded Git blob SHA-1. The source audit classifies 334 as exact-grid and two as non-comparable; this run independently re-checks profile and values.
metric: Exact full-raster values and exact positive-support mask within the finite template footprint; Jaccard=(intersection/union) for positive support.
caveat: Bounded comparison of the artifacts listed by the 2026-10-06 owner audit only. It is not global uniqueness proof and says nothing about geological validity or score attribution.
